vb_textbox.text: At the beginning, choose the gnome with the tallest hat, which should give a larger amount of points. The amount of points this gnome gives is starting to run out, so when this happens, switch to the smaller hat goblin. Once the points for this one start running out, switch again. Remember, it is important to focus on the height of their hats. At some point after half of the game, I noticed that the taller hat goblin gives 0 points a few times, so I focused more on the smaller hat goblin for a couple minutes, but then the game returns to the regular pattern that it had before, until the end.
